messages:
yara: heads-up — prepping release for inference-router v4 (eu-west). Plan: conservative feature-flag ramp + 'degen-mode' backstop (routes affected users to a smaller, cheaper model) + session-pin for live users. Posting runbook for sign-off.

deploybot: window 2026-05-10 23:00 UTC. Ramp steps: 1,5,25,100 with 10m soak. Degen backstop behavior: on anomaly, route affected cohorts to `inference-degen` and hold traffic at prior safe step. Runbook example: `/deploybot ff ramp --name=inference-router-v4 --steps=1,5,25,100 --soak=10m --backstop=degen --pin=live_sessions --monitor=inference.router.canary`

tom: +1. Can we start at 0.5% for the first step if cohort slicing allows fractional splits? Also request deploybot post cohort counts + error deltas after each step.

sre_oncall: I'll take watch for the first 45m. Alert rules: error-rate increase >2% absolute for 4m OR p95 latency >400ms -> trigger degen backstop for affected cohorts; if REQ_ERRORS >3x baseline for 2m -> emergency disable (`/deploybot ff set inference-router-v4 0`) and pin rollback cohorts to v3. I'll spin up a short dashboard and enable request traces.

infra: we'll pre-pin previous stable version v3 for cohorts live_sessions,paid_accounts for 1h to keep rollback deterministic. Pin command: `/infra ff pin --name=inference-router-v4 --cohorts=live_sessions,paid_accounts --version=v3 --duration=1h`. Auto-unpin only after 30m stability at 100% or manual approval.

yara: release notes draft: "inference-router v4 staged rollout with degen-mode backstop and session-pin for live users. Canary metrics, cohort-level observations, and rollback steps included." Adding runbook snippet to release doc.

sre_oncall: rollback procedure: run `/deploybot ff set inference-router-v4 0` then `/infra ff unpin --name=inference-router-v4 --cohorts=live_sessions,paid_accounts` validate v3 health for 15m before clearing. I'll post live updates in this thread during the window. :white_check_mark:
